item.title: POWERGRID Commissions Key Transmission Link for Rajasthan's 8.1 GW Solar Zones
item.description: Power Grid Corporation of India Ltd (POWERGRID), a Maharatna public sector undertaking, has completed a crucial inter-state transmission project designed to channel renewable energy from Rajasthan's expansive solar hubs into the national grid. Through its wholly owned subsidiary, POWERGRID Bhadla Sikar Transmission Limited, the company fully commissioned the infrastructure strengthening scheme for the 8.1 GW Solar Energy Zones in Rajasthan under Phase II - Part E. item.title: Acme Solar Operationalize 68 MW Out Of 100MW Wind Project in Gujarat
item.description: Gurugram-based ACME Solar Holdings Limited (ACME Solar), through its subsidiary ACME Eco Clean Energy Pvt Ltd, has commissioned an additional 12 MW of its wind power project in Surendranagar, Gujarat. This takes the project’s total operational capacity to 68 MW, out of the total 100 MW being commissioned in phases. item.title: ABB Ships First Wind Converter From Bengaluru Facility After Gamesta Electric Acquisition
item.description: Following the acquisition of Gamesa Electric’s power electronics business in Spain in December 2025, ABB has now dispatched its first wind power converter in India. In a press release, the company said it plans to manufacture and ship wind power converters from its Nelamangala facility in Bengaluru, India.
